'''Bindy Bend''' was located between [[Canyon Dune Turn/Legends|Canyon Dune Turn]] and [[The Coil/Legends|the Coil]] on the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] racetrack. Podracer pilots were forced to keep to the outside of the bend, away from a large stone spindle while making the turn. The inside rocks were jagged and extremely hazardous to navigate.<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
